question: The element used as a fuse ___________ when a huge current flows through it.
solution:
The correct answer is__** melts**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **element used as a fuse melts when a huge current flows through it.**
 
• This is **because the fuse** is made of a metal with a low melting point. 
 
• A **fuse is a safety device that protects a circuit from excess current. **
 
• It's made of a metal with a low melting point and high resistance.&
